notes: Public callable: ttnn.operations.all_to_all_matmul:all_to_all_matmul (input_tensor, weight, *, cluster_axis, topology=Ring, num_links=2, memory_config=None, compute_kernel_config=None).

Assumption: the suite files were already in pre_migration/, staged on this run's branch; I took them to be this run's earlier work, checked them against the contract (signature, SUPPORTED, every listed raise, golden helpers) and ran them unchanged. The driver-written route section is untouched.
Source run (run_safe_pytest.sh --run-all --no-precompile, test_acceptance.py + test_golden_cut.py): 67 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, on a 1x4 ring (G=4 along cluster_axis 1).

Acceptance coverage: one miss-then-hit case per planner branch (14); cache round trips for weight dtype, output buffer, fp32 DEST, math fidelity, rows per device, alignment and N width; optional arguments absent/present/absent; valid/invalid/valid; fresh buffers with a bit-identical repeat; bit-exact row/head provenance (aligned and non-aligned); 23 refusals asserting ValueError, NotImplementedError (UnsupportedAxisValue) or RuntimeError (planner R2, head slots per core, R3) with expect_error; non-default fabric payloads of 4160 B and 7232 B.

Golden cut: every SUPPORTED value, the smallest and largest golden INPUTS (DeepSeek, bf16 and bf8b), wide N 8192, deep K 4096, two non-aligned shapes and the four LOOSE_CASES, each checked with the golden suite's prepare_all_to_all_matmul reference and tolerances.

Not reachable on a 1x4 ring, so not tested: a Ring with no wrap link, a fabric payload smaller than one tile, the planner refusals for header-pool overflow and a route leaving through neither ring neighbour, and cluster_axis 0 with G > 1.

Probes 001, 002 and 031 only inspect planner internals (routes, ethernet channels, the 7232 B payload plan); test_fabric_packet_size[kimi_production_7232B] covers the payload scenario, so no case was added.
